<!-- pr-reviewer: 9b25a4dc317ca259c7967fc07919a3eba15fbbf7 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The corrected headers name the current module owners. The two new selection tests check the real suite headers. The decision record and `Process change: yes` line meet the current upstream rules.

Local results after a clean trial merge with upstream/main `3f41b8da6b65b8154132878e459d4430e3fb2063`:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: all four steps passed.
- App test build: passed for both affected binaries.
- `adaptive_fig8_crossing`: 0 passed, 2 ignored under the existing release-heavy rule.
- `shipped_from_disk`: 3 passed.
- xtask: 149 unit tests and 6 integration tests passed. This includes both new selection tests and the existing gate-map law.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p xtask -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Environment note: the first gate failed two shipped-file tests. Cargo 1.100 put the binary in `target/debug/build/camcraft-app/<hash>/out`. The existing resolver did not recognize that layout. The failures were `Fanuc: no path` and `no machines folder found`. I linked this worktree's assets beside that binary in the temporary build directory. All three tests and the repeated quick gate then passed. No source file changed.

This PR changes test selection metadata and tests only. It does not change posted G-code, geometry, simulation, or collision checks. No golden files changed. I did not run mutations or the ignored machining tests. No UI files changed, so screenshots are not required.

Requested changes: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
